battle.name: 危地馬拉內戰
battle.brief: 危地馬拉內戰於1960年11月爆發，是這份戰爭列表所列、以危地馬拉全境為戰場的長期內部衝突。施拿甫步槍（Sharps rifle）自1865年開始服役，屬美製遠射程步槍，採用單發栓動結構，作為步兵個人肩射武器，其服役年代早於本衝突爆發時間。

kit.name: 施拿甫步槍
kit.history: 施拿甫步槍屬美國陸軍早期遠射程步槍系列，以單發栓動方式供步兵射手使用；它是步兵個人用肩射武器，負責中遠距離精準射擊，並非機關槍或砲兵裝備。

countries: 本紀錄把「危地馬拉內戰（1960）」界定為一九六〇年十一月九日發生於危地馬拉城、由國防軍內部軍官發動的失敗政變，也就是後來史家常以一九六〇年為起點的危地馬拉內戰序章。直接交戰關係只有危地馬拉中央政府及其國防軍，與由現役軍官臨時集結的叛方；叛方沒有另行建國，也沒有可獨立運作的國界、兵站或外交後勤。美國是當時危地馬拉重要的軍援與外交參與者，但沒有可確認的美國地面部隊直接參加本次交火；墨西哥與古巴同樣不是這一天可核實的交戰方。作戰地理集中於首都的軍用營區、廣播中樞與政府指揮節點，後續全國性游擊戰不能倒灌進這次集中於十一月九日至十日、為期約一晝夜的兵變。
countriesEn: This record defines the Guatemalan Civil War of 1960 as the failed coup launched from within Guatemala’s defense establishment in Guatemala City on 9 November 1960, the episode later chroniclers often treat as the opening chapter of the longer Guatemalan Civil War. The only belligerent relationship was between the central government and its defense forces on one side and a rebel grouping assembled temporarily from serving officers on the other. The rebels did not create a state, and they possessed no independent border, railhead, or diplomatic logistics. The United States was an important source of military aid and diplomatic engagement in Guatemala at the time, but no United States ground force can be confirmed as having fought in the action. Mexico and Cuba likewise were not verifiable belligerents on that day. The operational geography was confined to the capital’s military compounds, broadcast nodes, and government command points. The later nationwide guerrilla war cannot be projected backward into a coup concentrated on 9 and 10 November and fought over roughly one day and one night.
people: 本次行動所瞄準的法定權力中樞是危地馬拉總統曼努埃爾・阿尤・加西亞。叛方企圖以軍隊控制迫使政府中樞改組、讓位或承認既成事實，而不是建立另一個國家。公開史料最常指名的策劃者是國防軍軍官馬里奧・福斯特・門德斯；英文資料常稱他為 Major Mario Foster，但不同語言版本的軍銜表述並不完全一致。他不能與後來游擊隊的司令混為一談，後來形成的「武裝革命力量」也不是這次兵變的原有建制。忠於阿尤的各支國防軍單位沒有留下同等完整而穩定的指揮姓名記錄，因此本篇採用「政府軍」與「叛方軍官」標示作戰關係，不補寫不確定的上將、旅長或營長姓名。福斯特在政變覆滅後死亡；通行材料不足以統一判定他是陣亡於交火，還是被俘後遭處置，故只確認其未生還，不虛構具體死亡方式。
peopleEn: The constitutional authority targeted by the action was Guatemalan President Manuel Ayau García. The rebels sought to use armed control of the capital to force a change in the government center, compel a transfer of power, or secure recognition of accomplished facts, rather than establish a separate state. The planner most frequently identified in the surviving literature is defense officer Mario Foster Méndez, usually called Major Mario Foster in English-language accounts, although rank translations differ between languages. He must not be conflated with a later guerrilla commander: the Armed Forces Rebels that emerged afterward were not an established organization in this coup. The units loyal to Ayau did not leave an equally complete or stable set of command names, so this account identifies them as government forces and rebel officers without inventing uncertain generals, colonels, or battalion commanders. Foster died after the coup collapsed. The standard accounts do not establish with sufficient consistency whether he was killed during the fighting or executed after capture, so the record confirms only that he did not survive and does not invent a precise manner of death.
kits: 裝備須區分「一九六〇年前已列裝的軍方系統」與「有事件證據證明實際投入的裝備」。在前一項，可列出的真實型號包括M1加蘭德步槍、湯普森M1928A1，亦常稱M1A1、M3衝鋒槍、勃朗寧M1911A1手槍、M1A1及M2卡賓槍、勃朗寧M1919A4輕機槍，以及M2型十二點七公厘與十二點七公厘重機槍。步兵防護與支援裝備可包括M1鋼盔、M1破片手榴彈及M2煙幕手榴彈。軍方火力與後勤序列另有M1及M2型一〇五公釐榴彈砲、Dodge WC-51與WC-52四輪驅動車、GMC CCKW-353二點五噸卡車，以及AN/SCR-300與AN/BC-114A無線電。相應實彈包括口徑三〇・〇六的M1與M2普通彈、M2穿甲彈、M1曳光彈，口徑四五ACP的M1911手槍彈，以及卡賓槍使用的一〇五公釐高爆彈與實彈。現存通行敘述沒有列出福斯特突擊分隊的逐件武器，因此不能把某一型步槍硬指定給每名叛方軍官；叛方裝備只能確認來自國防軍現役庫存。事件層面亦無可靠證據顯示坦克、飛機或榴彈砲實際參與交火，故不把它們寫成已投入的戰場裝備。
kitsEn: Equipment must be separated into systems fielded before 1960 and equipment for which this particular action provides positive evidence. In the first category, the real models include the M1 Garand rifle, M1928A1 Thompson, also commonly called the M1A1, M3 submachine gun, Browning M1911A1 pistol, M1A1 and M2 carbines, Browning M1919A4 light machine gun, and M2 Browning machine guns in .30 and .50 caliber. Individual protection and support equipment included the M1 steel helmet, M1 fragmentation grenade, and M2 smoke grenade. The military fire-support and logistics inventory also included M1 and M2 105 mm howitzers, Dodge WC-51 and WC-52 four-wheel-drive trucks, GMC CCKW-353 2.5-ton trucks, and AN/SCR-300 and AN/BC-114A radios. Corresponding ammunition included .30-06 M1 and M2 ball ammunition, M2 armor-piercing ammunition, M1 tracer ammunition, .45 ACP M1911 pistol ammunition, and 105 mm high-explosive and target rounds. The standard surviving accounts do not provide an itemized weapons list for Foster’s assault parties, so no particular rifle can honestly be assigned to every rebel officer; the rebels can only be shown drawing equipment from the defense establishment’s active stocks. There is likewise no reliable event-level evidence that tanks, aircraft, or howitzers actually entered the fighting, and they are therefore not presented as deployed battlefield systems.
tactics: 叛方採取的是首都內部控制型奇襲，而不是先進行縱深火力準備。其作戰鏈可以分為三段：第一段是在首都軍用營區及軍官間迅速集結，避免政府機關在第一時間完成指揮；第二段是奪取廣播或通訊節點，利用突然取得的發言時間宣稱權力已轉移，使忠於政府的各單位必須先判斷哪一組命令有效；第三段才是向政府指揮節點施壓，企圖把控制廣播轉化為控制首都。事件沒有留下可交叉核對的完整街名路線，因此最可靠的戰術重建不是虛構逐棟戰鬥，而是依上述三段控制鏈及包圍順序描述。政府的反應同樣以控制節點為核心：各忠誠單位先由駐地確認彼此身分，再向叛方控制點收攏，切斷其與其他駐軍及後續彈藥來源的聯繫。叛方即使短暫控制廣播，也未能同時取得足夠的地面兵力與補給，於是戰局由政變競速轉成被包圍的孤立據點。現有材料不支持坦克衝鋒大規模炮擊或空中掃射等說法，正面交火仍以步槍、衝鋒槍、手槍及機槍為主。
tacticsEn: The rebels adopted a control-oriented surprise inside the capital rather than opening with a prolonged fire-preparation. Their operational chain can be divided into three phases. First, they concentrated rapidly in military compounds and among officers so that government agencies could not organize command at once. Second, they seized a broadcast or communications node and used the sudden access to announce a transfer of power, forcing units loyal to the government to determine which order possessed effective authority. Third, they applied pressure toward government command points in an effort to convert control of the airwaves into control of the capital. The event has not left a complete, cross-checkable street-by-street route, so the safest tactical reconstruction follows this three-stage control chain and the sequence of containment rather than inventing building-by-building combat. The government response was similarly centered on command nodes: loyal units first confirmed one another from their posts and then converged on rebel positions, separating the rebels from other garrisons and later sources of ammunition. Even after briefly controlling the broadcast, the rebels lacked enough simultaneous ground strength and supply to convert a propaganda coup into territorial control. The action consequently changed from a race for authority into an isolated position under containment. Available evidence does not support tank charges, mass artillery fire, or air attacks; direct combat was principally conducted with rifles, submachine guns, pistols, and machine guns.
data: 時間線只能建立在可靠的日級節點上。首先，在十一月九日以前，現役軍官之間已有反對現政府的串聯，但公開概述沒有提供一致的會議日期、加入名單或正式奪權綱領，因此不能虛構倒數計時式的準備過程。十一月九日晨間，叛方在首都控制部分軍用據點，並利用通訊與廣播設施先行宣稱政府權力已易手；這一舉動造成短暫的雙重權威局面。忠於曼努埃爾・阿尤的國防軍各單位隨即向核心區域調動，叛方則企圖擴大其已取得的節點，但控制範圍沒有發展成能持續獲得援軍與彈藥的完整防區。九月九日白天至夜間的主要對抗，是忠誠部隊逐步切斷叛方連絡、包圍其控制點，並迫使殘餘人員失去抵抗能力；最遲至十一月十日，核心抵抗已結束，倖存的涉案軍官遭到拘押、撤職或處置。福斯特未生還，其他軍官亦有陣亡、受傷及被俘的記錄，但可靠來源沒有提供可核對的雙方精確傷亡總數，因此本篇不採納任何單一精確數字。能確定的結果是政變失敗、政府軍恢復控制首都，而參戰各支部的實際人數、彈藥基數及逐件裝備仍屬史料空白。
dataEn: The chronology can be established only from reliable day-level milestones. Before 9 November, serving officers had already made contacts directed against the existing government, but standard summaries do not provide consistent meeting dates, a verified participant roll, or a formal program for taking power. Accordingly, no artificial countdown-style preparation sequence is invented. On the morning of 9 November, the rebels controlled some military positions in the capital and used communications and broadcasting facilities to announce first that governmental authority had changed hands, creating a brief period of dual authority. Defense units loyal to Manuel Ayau then moved toward the central area. The rebels attempted to enlarge the nodes they already held, but their control never developed into a coherent perimeter capable of receiving reinforcements and ammunition on a sustained basis. During the day and night of 9 November, loyal units progressively cut rebel communications, enclosed their positions, and deprived the remaining men of the ability to resist. By 10 November at the latest, organized resistance had ended, and surviving officers involved were arrested, removed from command, or otherwise punished. Foster did not survive, and other officers were killed, wounded, or captured. Reliable sources do not provide a verifiable total for casualties on either side, so no single precise figure is adopted. The firm outcome is that the coup failed and government forces regained control of the capital, while the strengths, ammunition bases, and itemized equipment of the participating detachments remain blank in the surviving record.
cause: 這次兵變沒有留下一份能夠單獨說明全部動機的宣言，較可靠的解釋是數項軍隊內部矛盾同時成熟。首要因素是部分軍官不滿總統阿尤時期的指揮安排、晉用標準及政治權力對軍隊的介入，希望以武裝政變迫使中央政府改組。其制度背景則源於一九五四年政變後危地馬拉軍隊在美援體系中迅速擴張，軍官既獲得更多裝備與資源，也更接近國家政治決策中心；擴權與不滿因此容易交疊。區域層面，一九五九年古巴革命後的冷戰氣氛使軍內對共產主義與外部勢力的戒備升高，部分軍官也可能以反對外部干預作為政治語言，但沒有可靠文件證明福斯特一行直接接受古巴命令，也不能僅因美國提供軍援便推論華盛頓策劃或執行本次政變。總之，軍官派系不滿與軍隊在後一九五四年政治中的地位，是較直接的背景；後來游擊戰爭的社會與政治議題則不能倒過來充當一九六〇年這次短促兵變的動機。
causeEn: The coup left no single manifesto capable of explaining all of its motives, and the most reliable interpretation is that several internal tensions in the military matured at the same time. The immediate factor was the dissatisfaction of some officers with command arrangements, promotion practices under President Ayau, and political intervention in the armed forces. They sought to compel a change in the central government through an armed coup. The institutional background was the rapid expansion of Guatemala’s military within the American aid system after the 1954 coup. Officers gained more equipment and resources while also gaining closer access to national political decisions, allowing military resentments and institutional influence to overlap. At the regional level, the Cold War atmosphere following the Cuban Revolution in 1959 heightened concern within the officer corps about communism and foreign influence. Some rebels may also have used opposition to outside interference as political language, but no reliable document shows that Foster’s group took orders from Havana, and the provision of American aid does not establish that Washington planned or executed this coup. In short, factional dissatisfaction within the officer corps and the military’s enlarged political role after 1954 form the most direct background; the political issues of the later guerrilla conflict cannot be projected backward as the motive for this short coup.
impact: 立即影響是阿尤政府沒有因兵變而中斷，中央行政與國防軍指揮仍在首都運作，叛方未能控制政府部會、國防軍總部或足以延續行動的防區。軍事層面的後果則更嚴重：涉案軍官被清除出指揮體系，部分遭到拘押或處置，國防軍內部對軍官政治活動、忠誠判定與後來晉用的戒心隨之升高。這次事件因此既是一次被壓制的政變，也是一次暴露軍隊內部分裂的安全事件。就長期歷史而言，一些概論把一九六〇年列為危地馬拉內戰的起點，另一些則把真正持續的武裝衝突起於一九六六年；採用一九六〇年者，重點是它揭示了軍隊內部對政治的不滿，而不是斷言它直接產生了後來的游擊組織。外部大國雖密切注意危地馬拉局勢，卻沒有以地面部隊介入這場交火。事件的領土結果近乎空白，主要改變發生在軍隊領導、指揮互信與政治清算方面，而精確傷亡總數仍無可靠定論。
impactEn: The immediate effect was the uninterrupted survival of Ayau’s government. Central administration and defense command remained functional in the capital, and the rebels failed to take the government ministries, the defense headquarters, or a perimeter capable of sustaining the action. The military consequences were more severe. Officers involved were removed from the command structure, some were arrested or punished, and the defense forces became more sensitive to political activity by officers, questions of loyalty, and subsequent promotion decisions. The episode was consequently both a suppressed coup and a security crisis that exposed divisions inside the military. In the longer historical account, some surveys date the beginning of the Guatemalan Civil War to 1960, while others place the sustained armed conflict in 1966. Those choosing 1960 emphasize that the event revealed military dissatisfaction with politics, not that it directly created the later guerrilla organizations. Outside powers followed the situation closely but did not intervene with ground forces. The action produced almost no territorial change; its principal effects fell on military leadership, confidence between commanders, and political purges, while a reliable total casualty figure remains unresolved.
result: 結果是中央政府的明確勝利。福斯特一方在首都短暫取得軍用據點與廣播手段，但沒有把這兩項優勢擴展為對政府指揮系統和後勤來源的實體控制；忠誠國防軍則利用更快的部隊集結、對叛方連絡的逐步切斷與包圍，使政變競速轉為孤立據點的解除武裝。福斯特未生還，其餘骨幹或被俘、或遭撤職處置，叛方沒有奪取總統府、沒有更替政府，也沒有建立可供持續作戰的政治或軍事替代秩序。曼努埃爾・阿尤繼續擔任總統至一九六四年一月，短暫兵變在最初數小時內雖使首都出現權威真空，卻未形成可持續的戰爭前沿。從戰役判讀，本次行動是一次由控制型政變轉為被包圍失敗的首都奪權嘗試；其直接成果是政府軍復歸首都、國防軍進行內部清理，而非後續危地馬拉內戰的終局。
resultEn: The result was a decisive victory for the central government. Foster’s side briefly secured military positions and broadcasting facilities in the capital, but it could not extend those advantages into physical control of the government command system and its sources of logistics. Loyal defense forces used faster unit concentration, the progressive cutting of rebel communications, and encirclement to turn the race for authority into the disarmament of an isolated position. Foster did not survive. Other principal participants were captured or removed and punished. The rebels did not take the presidential palace, did not replace the government, and did not create a political or military alternative capable of sustaining operations. Manuel Ayau remained president until January 1964. Although the brief coup created a temporary ambiguity of authority in the capital during its first hours, it never developed into a durable front. As a campaign record, this was an attempt to seize power in the capital by control of key nodes that evolved into the suppression of an enclosed coup force. Its immediate outcome was the government’s recovery of the capital and an internal purge within the defense forces, not the conclusion of the later Guatemalan Civil War.
